title: Character
description: A carrier of threads. Stable roster entry; alignment/faction can shift via arc, but the character id is stable.

alignment.description: Current alignment. Snapshots; revise when the character turns.

faction.description: Faction id or null. References factions if faction registry added later.

archetype.description: Worked Shoot archetype assignment, e.g. 'Grail', 'Bound-Loki'. Null if not framework-tagged.

register.description: Worked Shoot framework tier (Pantheon, Constant, Liminal-Warrior, etc.).

notes.description: Free-text context (recent injury, hibernation, registry refinement, etc.).
